notes: Outputs for the 21 dockerfile_block items, engine:image (docker_image), engine:image-data, engine:registry-image-data and the new dockerfile:data-dockerfile.

Every Dockerfile flag is a typed field checked against reference.md (frontend 1.28.0); min_syntax only where reference.md states a 'Minimum Dockerfile version' or 'since Dockerfile v1.x'. ADD has no --from and no heredoc in reference.md, so none is modelled. Heredocs carry no min_syntax (none stated).
Block identity = instruction keyword + stage_index + instruction_index (directives: the directive name, which is file-level and unique). No allowed_violations needed.
Each block also has a raw `dockerfile` (the block rendered) + content_sha256, so a consumer can hand off one instruction as text.

Field-level extra keys: min_syntax, anchor (doc anchor), options (documented values), sensitive (per field), see (item id whose shape a nested object takes), filled_by (local/registry/image), existing_attribute on outputs (today's attribute carrying the same value under another name).

Sensitive: ENV values and ARG defaults (dockerfile:ENV, dockerfile:ARG, and every whole-file dockerfile/stages/global_args output), ImageConfig.Env (config, inspect, inspect_json of docker_image and data.docker_image), image history CreatedBy (build-arg values, per reference.md ARG warning).

Not sensitive by decision: RUN --mount=type=secret. The Dockerfile carries only the secret id, target and env-var name, never the value; values live only in docker_image build.secrets, read at build and never stored. Flip dockerfile:RUN run/dockerfile to sensitive if secret ids must be hidden too.

data.docker_image and data.docker_registry_image share identity (id, name, image_ref, image_digest_ref, digest, platforms, labels, created), structured (manifests, config, inspect) and version outputs; inspect/inspect_json mirror each side's own upstream model (ImageInspect vs DistributionInspect). labels, created, config and manifests[].digest/media_type/size/available are local-only (filled_by).

Image-mode fidelity: Image mode cannot recover a Dockerfile. It rebuilds an approximate single-stage instruction list from the image history (ImageHistoryResponseItem.CreatedBy, newest first, reversed) plus ImageConfig for the final CMD/ENTRYPOINT/ENV/EXPOSE/USER/WORKDIR/LABEL/HEALTHCHECK/SHELL/STOPSIGNAL/VOLUME values, so fidelity = approximate: FROM and earlier stages are lost (base-image layers appear as leading history entries), COPY/ADD sources are only content hashes, RUN --mount/--network/--security flags and heredoc structure are not recorded, and images built by other tools may have empty or squashed history. History CreatedBy records build-arg values, so image-mode stages/history/dockerfile are sensitive.
No OCI image-spec file is harvested under reference/upstream, so the history path is cited via swagger ImageHistoryResponseItem (x-go-name HistoryResponseItem) only.
naming_questions: docker_image and data.docker_image expose `repo_digest`; the contract name is `image_digest_ref`: rename (breaking), add `image_digest_ref` and deprecate `repo_digest`, or keep `repo_digest` as the contract name?

data.docker_registry_image exposes `sha256_digest` (= contract `digest`) and `id` = `<name>@<digest>` (≈ `image_digest_ref`): add `digest` + `image_digest_ref` and deprecate `sha256_digest`, or keep the current names?
`image_id` duplicates `id` on docker_image and data.docker_image: keep both, or deprecate `image_id`?
data.docker_dockerfile: expose the original input text as a second raw output (`source_dockerfile` + `source_dockerfile_sha256`) beside the re-rendered `dockerfile`, or only the rendered form?
Structured output name on each dockerfile_block item: the lowercase keyword (`run`, `copy`, `from`, current) or one uniform name (`block`)?
data.docker_dockerfile image mode: name the provenance outputs `reconstructed` + `fidelity` (current, both identity) or a single `fidelity` (`exact`/`approximate`)?
